node.title: Compresión narrativa de capacidad
node.summary: A compact model or story communicates complex practices and dependencies.

relations: Narrative compression becomes operationally consequential when the simplified model is used as the control surface for decisions that depend on omitted conditions.
No toda simplificación es falsa ni toda divergencia produce el mismo daño; hay que observar la decisión y su efecto.
Reconstructing what a model omitted is different from recovering a capability that has ceased to be exercised; the bridge note keeps those repair problems distinct.
La irreversibilidad del marco requiere contraste; el enlace distingue problemas y no establece una tasa universal de pérdida.
One testable link is whether the visible model receives resources and credit while the less visible capabilities on which it depends remain under-attributed.
No se infiere intención de apropiación a partir de una narrativa atractiva; se necesitan registros de contribución y atribución.
The Level 1.5 transition offers a practical check on narrative compression by tracing how field observations, dependencies and responsibilities become architecture.
El análisis intermedio no garantiza fidelidad completa; debe conservar incertidumbres y contrastarse de nuevo en operación.
The JUBAP sequence is more useful when each stage retains the capabilities and operating conditions required for it to work, rather than becoming a ritualized checklist.
Comparación metodológica; no se atribuye al artículo una aplicación documentada de todas las etapas actuales de JUBAP.
The HR rationalization case makes the distinction concrete: preparing an executable architecture and handover is a different result from completing the full rollout.
La preparación del caso está descrita; el vínculo no atribuye al mismo equipo una implantación posterior no acreditada.
The invisible-talent model offers a useful counterpoint to symbolic celebration: capability remains alive through formation, operational missions and opportunities to exercise judgment.
No se afirma que el caso de formación haya sido diseñado para resolver el ciclo descrito por LatinoEmpresa.
Narrative compression is one possible visibility mechanism to examine when contribution and attribution diverge; it should be traced through actual resource and authority decisions.
No toda omisión editorial es captura de valor. Se propone un mecanismo posible, no una acusación sobre actores concretos.
Narrative convergence should not be counted as independent corroboration when several statements inherit the same underlying source or compressed frame.
La cascada de 00G es construida; no se atribuye ese incidente a las instituciones descritas por LatinoEmpresa.
